# CARCAVELOS FORECAST – Thursday 13 August

**Small, consistent swell with light winds this morning before afternoon sea breeze kicks in.**

**Morning (sunrise to 11am):** Glassy conditions with 1m waves and light northerly winds under 10km/h. Best window is 6am–9am when wind drops to its lightest. Water temps at 20°C. Expect small, peaky peaks and a spread-out crowd—perfect for a relaxed session.

**Progression:** Winds shift to NNW and build steadily through midday. By 2pm, 15+ km/h winds start chopping the face. Wave heights tick up slightly to 1.1–1.15m by mid-afternoon, but quality deteriorates.

**Afternoon:** Skip it unless you're chasing slightly bigger waves and don't mind rougher conditions. Wind stays 17–20km/h through sunset.

**Tips:** Go early or don't go at all. Grab a shortboard for the light morning swell. High pressure = thermometer hits 28°C by 3pm—bring water.
